title: Vallee's own UFO sighting at age 15

tellings.quote: after I saw when I was 15 I saw that object outside the room over the the yard

plain: A researcher named Jacques Vallée, who has studied UFO reports for decades, tells Michels that when he was 15, growing up in France in the 1950s, he saw an object outside his room, hanging over the yard. He tells it as his own sighting, one that came before his lifetime of work on the subject.
